article.story: MISSOULA, Mont. -- — Tuburu Niavalurua's 21 points helped Oakland defeat Lamar 83-68 on Monday. Niavalurua added three steals for the Golden Grizzlies (2-5). Michael Houge scored 16 points and added eight rebounds. Isaac Garrett had 16 points and shot 7 of 10 from the field and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line. Andrew Holifield finished with 15 points, nine rebounds and two blocks for the Cardinals (3-2). Rob Lee Jr. added 13 points for Lamar. Errol White had 11 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
